panels.title: Avg Response Time — Slowest First
panels.description: Average total response time per engine (pre-computed gauge from SearXNG). Engines above 5 s are prime throttle/disable candidates.

panels.title: Result Yield — Lowest First (results/request, 1 h)
panels.description: Results returned per query over last hour. Below 1 result/request = poor contributor, review or disable.

panels.title: Reliability Event Rate — 24 h (highest = most active)
panels.description: Rate of reliability events over 24 h. Engines near zero may be broken or never selected by the router.

panels.title: Error Rate by Engine × Error Type (5 m rate)
panels.description: From error-exporter. Types: timeout, read_timeout, rate_limited, access_denied, http_error. No data = no errors yet or error-exporter not running.

panels.title: Dead Engines — Zero Requests in Last 1 h
panels.description: No queries in the past hour. No data = all engines active. Listed engines are candidates for removal from settings.yml.

panels.title: Response Time Trend per Engine
panels.description: Avg response time over time. Use the Engine variable to filter. Spot engines that degrade at specific times of day.

panels.title: CAPTCHA Events by Engine (1 h increase)
panels.description: Counts CAPTCHA suspensions per engine parsed from SearXNG container logs. Each spike = engine was bot-detected and suspended (SearxEngineCaptcha: 3600s). Zero = healthy.

panels.title: Parse Errors by Engine (1 h increase)
panels.description: JSON decode failures and IndexErrors (e.g. google HTML parser breakage, semantic scholar empty response). Persistent parse_errors indicate the engine's upstream changed their response format — consider disabling or awaiting SearXNG update.

panels.title: Error Totals by Type (since exporter start)
panels.description: Running totals since the searxng-error-exporter container last started. Shows which error categories are most common across all engines.
